runtimes.value: Ollama official qwen3-vl:30b (no video input #18151; thinking variant can loop #17978); llama.cpp llama-server + mmproj (ggml-org Instruct Q8_0 GGUF); LM Studio (lmstudio-community GGUF and MLX 4-8 bit, Instruct and Thinking); mlx-vlm with mlx-community builds (3-8 bit, bf16); transformers (MPS unverified)
runtimes.note: Ollama issue status from an earlier check (13.11.2026), not re-checked. Video input outside Ollama (mlx-vlm, transformers) not verified.

web.scope: Searched on 13.11.2026. Sources: Hacker News comments, Hugging Face discussions, Ollama, llama.cpp and mlx-lm issues. **Reddit could not be read** (blocked for automated reading); summaries of Reddit threads by other sites were not used as evidence. Released 30.09.2025; window: since 13.05.2026. **Feedback thin**; no direct comparison with Qwen3.6.
web.summary: Works but slow; the built-in vision of Qwen3.6 and Qwen3.8 gets more praise, so a separate vision model may not be needed.
web.verdict: Works but slow; Qwen3.6/3.8 built-in vision praised more; thin feedback

comments.text: Slow: 15–30 s per image; quality quite good, if a bit verbose ([vunderba, 13.05.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48117409)).

Ollama cannot send it video ([ollama#18151](https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/18151)); the thinking variant can loop without answering ([ollama#17978](https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/17978)).
Used daily to caption NAS photos into EXIF and a search index ([vunderba, 14.05.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48141957)).
For its possible replacement: the vision of Qwen3.6 is judged excellent ([scotty79, 15.06.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48544119)).
